sql: SELECT index_id, value, avail_season, avail_doy FROM climate WHERE index_id IN ('oni','pdo') ORDER BY avail_t DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT cls, count(*) n_rows, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt, sum(yt)*1.0/nullif(sum(anglers),0) ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy <= 32
GROUP BY cls ORDER BY ypa DESC

SELECT cls, fish_date_doy, count(distinct boat) boats, sum(anglers) anglers, sum(yt) yt, sum(yt)*1.0/nullif(sum(anglers),0) ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy <= 32 AND cls IN ('day_1_5','three_quarter')
GROUP BY cls, fish_date_doy ORDER BY cls, fish_date_doy
